title: GI conformance examples manifest
description: manifest.json lists every example file in valid/ and invalid/ once, with the reader outcome it must produce when read as GI against the job given in the entry, with every gate closed (the desk view).

file.description: Path relative to gi-examples/, with forward slashes. valid/ files expect ok, invalid/ files expect refused.

expect.description: ok: the reader reports no finding of severity refuse. refused: it reports at least one, among them finding_id on line.

finding_id.description: With expect refused: a refusing finding the reader must report. With expect ok: a warning it must report. Ids are listed in gi-format.md, section Findings.

line.description: The line the finding must name (1-based, counted like .NET File.ReadAllLines).

assert_moves.description: Moves the reader's raw program must contain: the move read from line ends at end (X, Y, Z as written in the file, within 0.0005 mm; ZSHIFT is never applied) and, for an arc, sweeps sweep_deg degrees (within 0.001 degrees).

job.description: The job.toml values the GI header is compared with (gi-format.md, section The header against job.toml). The reader's test builds its job from these values; nothing is defaulted.

placement.description: Offset of the program on the panel, in mm. GI origin=t1-corner agrees only with (0, 0).
